answer: Sybil resistance is enforced through cryptographic staking on a distributed ledge, forcing agents to commit measurable value to gain protocol influence. Peer-to-peer liveness is validated via a periodic whisper signal. To dilute consensus, an attacker must surmount a significant capital knoll, where the marginal cost of creating additional identities remains prohibitively high due to the linear collateral requirements and the threat of algorithmic slashing.
